title: Settings
descriptionReadOnly: You can view workspace settings. Only Owners and Admins can change them.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.description: Used across every workspace and client portal you belong to.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing your password signs out your other sessions.

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: How your organization appears to clients.
organization.logoHint: PNG or JPG, up to 2 MB
organization.name: Organization name

email.title: Email
email.description: Phase 1 delivers notifications by email. SMS arrives in a later release.
email.outboxNote: (development outbox — messages are written to the server's .outbox folder)

auto.title: Automatic reminders
auto.description: The organization default. Forms, documents and assignments can override it.
auto.sendHint: Turn off to only send reminders manually.

rules.formAssigned: Notify when a form is assigned
rules.documentRejected: Notify when a document is rejected
rules.documentApproved: Notify when a document is approved
rules.expiringHint: Notify clients before a document expires.
rules.offsetsHint: For example “30, 7, 0” — 30 days before, 7 days before, and on the day.
rules.expiredHint: Notify clients when a document expires.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.description: Quiet hours and retry policy for failed sends.
delivery.quietHoursHint: Automatic messages that fall in quiet hours are sent when they end.
delivery.backoff: Retries back off exponentially from this interval.

notifications.futureOnly: Changes apply to future reminders only.

access.title: Portal access
access.description: Who can open your client portal. You can change this at any time.
access.privateDescription: Every client activates their own account from an invitation and only sees their own forms and documents.
access.publicDescription: Anyone with the link can submit your publicly shared forms without an account. Submissions are unverified and land in the Document Inbox.
access.inviteFirst: Invite clients on their first assignment
access.inviteFirstHint: Send the portal activation link together with the first form.
access.verifyHint: Clients must verify their email before opening the portal.

link.saveToGenerate: Save to generate your public link. Mark forms as “Share on the public portal” in the form builder.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: Shown to clients in the portal and in emails.
branding.welcomePlaceholder: Everything we need from you is on this page.

documents.title: Document settings
documents.description: Defaults for new document fields in the form builder.
